$comment: T-5.02: the slice mission (PLAN.md §7.12), made active by U-011. Five objectives across mission-01: clear the patrol holding the west lane, then the position holding the east lane, take the compound by putting its garrison down, start the upload at the terminal on the compound's crate and see it through while the counterattack goes for the lever in the compound's north-east corner, and fall back to the start line past an ambush. No stage is standing in a box for a timer: each is something to do (U-011, owner feedback 2026-09-26). Any soldier dying or all six going down fails the mission; nobody respawns before a retry or restart. Each objective completing is a checkpoint (T-4.16); the messages, callouts, the counterattack and the ambush are the script's (data/scripts/mission-01.json).
